message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This is a basic workflow to help you get started with Action 
name: CI

# Controls when the workflow will run
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true

# A workflow run is made  up of one or more jobs that can run sequentially or in parallel
jobs:
  coverage-test:
    name: Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Ruby 3.4
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.4
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: run specs
        run: bundle exec rake spec --trace
      - name: Verify SimpleCov threshold
        env:
          COVERAGE_THRESHOLD: "80"
        run: |
          ruby <<'RUBY'
          require "json"

          threshold = ENV.fetch("COVERAGE_THRESHOLD", "80").to_f
          last_run_path = "coverage/.last_run.json"

          unless File.exist?(last_run_path)
            abort "Coverage results missing: expected #{last_run_path}. Ensure specs completed and SimpleCov wrote results."
          end

          data = JSON.parse(File.read(last_run_path))
          coverage = data.dig("result", "line")

          unless coverage.is_a?(Numeric) || coverage.to_s.match?(/\A\d+(\.\d+)?\z/)
            abort "Invalid coverage value in #{last_run_path}: #{coverage.inspect}"
          end

          coverage = coverage.to_f

          puts format("Line coverage: %.2f%% (threshold: %.2f%%)", coverage, threshold)

          if coverage < threshold
            abort format("Coverage is less than %.2f%% (%.2f%%)", threshold, coverage)
          end
          RUBY",
  "rationale": "Add concurrency with cancel-in-progress to cancel superseded runs on the same branch/PR, reducing duplicate work. This is supported by the P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE experiment example (synthetic fixture) and the pattern catalogue, which indicates estimated VM time reduction. The workflow runs on push and pull_request to main, and the concurrency group per workflow and ref ensures isolation across branches while cancelling stale runs on the same ref. No contraindications apply (not a release/deployment workflow, distinct branches have separate groups).",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-560f8aa17cf2dbe5"]
}
